responsibility: This definition file is the master specification of GCC’s built-in machine modes and the declarative language understood by genmodes. It documents and instantiates the generic scalar, complex, vector, fixed-point, decimal-float, and random modes that exist independent of any one target, together with the macros for defining additional or adjusted modes in target-specific *-modes.def files. It is the authoritative source from which generated mode enums, tables, and relationships are derived.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/machmode.h, which exposes the generated machine-mode query interface, this .def file is the declarative master list of built-in modes and mode-definition macros consumed by genmodes to produce enums and tables.
